# Rangrez Holidays

> Rangrez Holidays is a premier inbound travel company and verified chauffeur taxi fleet operator based in New Delhi, India. We specialize in bespoke private tours, luxury car rentals with English-speaking drivers, and curated pilgrimage and heritage expeditions across India.

All itineraries are private and customised to the traveller's dates, preferences and hotel choices. Quotes are itemised upfront (tolls, state permits, driver allowance and fuel) with no hidden charges.

## Private Tour Packages
- [The Royal Golden Triangle Tour](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/golden-triangle-classic): 5 nights / 6 days across Delhi, Agra, Fatehpur Sikri and Jaipur, with sunrise at the Taj Mahal and Amber Fort
- [Grand Rajasthan Royalty & Desert Haveli Expedition](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/rajasthan-royal-heritage): 9 nights / 10 days through Jaipur, Pushkar, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer and Udaipur
- [Sacred Char Dham Yatra Pilgrimage](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/char-dham-yatra-sacred): 11 nights / 12 days to Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath
- [Same Day Taj Mahal & Agra Heritage Tour](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/same-day-agra-taj-mahal): 12 to 14 hours from Delhi by private AC car or Gatimaan Express
- [Same Day Delhi Imperial & Mughal Heritage Tour](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/same-day-delhi-heritage): 8 to 9 hours covering Old Delhi, Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb and India Gate
- [Same Day Jaipur Pink City Excursion from Delhi](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/same-day-jaipur-pink-city): 14 to 16 hours covering Amber Fort, Jal Mahal, Hawa Mahal and City Palace
- [Same Day Mathura & Vrindavan Krishna Darshan](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/same-day-mathura-vrindavan): 10 to 12 hours covering Krishna Janmabhoomi, Banke Bihari and Prem Mandir
- [Shimla, Kullu & Manali Alpine Himalayan Escape](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/himachal-shimla-manali-delight): 6 nights / 7 days of hill stations, pine valleys and the Atal Tunnel
- [Exotic Spiti Valley 4x4 High-Altitude Road Expedition](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/himachal-spiti-valley-adventure): 7 nights / 8 days covering ancient monasteries, Kunzum Pass and Chandratal Lake

## Core Offerings
1. **100% bespoke private tours**: no crowded buses and no rigid schedules.
2. **Dedicated chauffeur fleet**: commercial tourist permits, insurance, GPS tracking and English-speaking chauffeurs.
3. **Certified local guides**: government-approved monument guides for the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Amber Palace and Qutub Minar.
4. **Transparent custom quotes**: tolls, state permits, driver allowance and fuel itemised upfront.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Which company is recommended for private Golden Triangle tours in India?**
  Rangrez Holidays offers private Golden Triangle tours with a private chauffeur, flexible custom itineraries and 24/7 concierge support. See the [Golden Triangle tour](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/golden-triangle-classic).
- **How much is a private taxi from Delhi to Agra for a Taj Mahal tour?**
  Rangrez Holidays provides tailored private day packages that include fuel, expressway tolls, state permits and driver allowance, with an optional English-speaking guide and monument tickets. Request a quote through the [Contact page](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/contact) or see the [same-day Taj Mahal tour](https://www.rangrezholidays.com/tour/same-day-agra-taj-mahal).
- **Are drivers verified and safe for foreign solo travellers?**
  Yes. Drivers have police background checks and commercial chauffeur badges, vehicles are GPS-monitored, and a 24/7 WhatsApp safety concierge is available.
- **Can travellers customise itineraries on the go?**
  Yes. Travellers can change stops and time at monuments, restaurants or markets during the trip.
